title: [BUG] Gemini 3.0 Pro Preview doesn't work
body:
### Description

Can't run a crew with the Gemini 3 Pro model

### Steps to Reproduce

`LLM(model='google/gemini-3-pro-preview')`

linked_prs.title: feat: Add gemini-3-pro-preview
